title: The strong thin tree conjecture

abstractEnglish: We prove that every finite loopless k-edge-connected multigraph on at least two vertices, with k ≥ 1, has a spanning tree meeting each cut in at most $`C/k`$ times the size of the cut, where C is a universal constant. This resolves the strong thin tree conjecture.
